_readme: Copy this file to settings.json (same directory) and edit the 3 required fields: vault_dir, project_dir, python_cmd. python_cmd is the ABSOLUTE path to the python of this skill's own conda env (see README: conda create -n paper-kb python=3.10 -y; PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1 python -m pip install -r requirements.txt) — every tool, the MCP server and both hooks run on it. Keys starting with '_' are ignored. Use forward slashes / even on Windows. Then run: paper-kb-deploy --register  (or: python deploy.py --register; drop --register to only print the MCP registration command instead of writing it to your user-scope config)
_readme_openalex_mailto: 填你的邮箱进 OpenAlex 礼貌池（优先排队）。注意：它不补齐免费档的每-IP 一次性 credit（约百次查询）——大型 verify_refs 批次会撞墙，工具将熔断，窗口重置后用 --resume 补跑失败行即可
